name: hcw-azmigrateorchestrator-addon
description: Hybrid Cloud Works Migration Explorer — the slim web-front edition of the Azure Migration Orchestrator: CSV lab API, the pane app the website frames at /tools/migration, and site integration, built on the published core (ADR-0028). Workspace manifests use "*" for the two upstream packages during the interim: the exact pin is APP_REF (the upstream release tag) until the packages are installed from npm, when they become exact versions.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && npm run build --workspace apps/lab-web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npx playwright test
